# this by hand without adding the page to NAV — the build will tell you.

# ⚠️ The workflow's own drift check (sitemap vs manifest) is INERT in this repo
# and says so in the run summary: it looks for a COMMITTED sitemap.xml, and this
# site's is generated into site/dist/ at build time, which is gitignored. That
# is fine and is why the build-time assertion above exists instead — the two
# lists are checked against the array they both describe, which is strictly
# stronger than checking them against each other.
